name: Integrated Machinery Services
summary: Rotating equipment repair, machining, welding and field service for manufacturing plants, from a shop in Deer Park, Texas.

hero.eyebrow: Rotating equipment repair in Deer Park, Texas
hero.title: Reliable solutions that keep your operations
hero.lead: IMS repairs extrusion equipment, gearboxes, turbines, pumps, blowers, fans, rotary airlocks and valves, with machining, welding and field service under one roof. We provide the resources and solutions to get the job done right and on time.

about.title: Who is IMS?
text: Integrated Machinery Services is a dynamic and innovative company dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service and top-tier rotating equipment repair solutions. From diagnosis to repair and maintenance, our team of skilled professionals makes sure every job is carried out with precision and delivered on time.

With nearly a century of serving the manufacturing industry, we are ready to apply our expertise to the repair needs no matter how big or small. If it is made out of metal and comes out of a piece of machinery, we know how to manufacture or fix it.
The shop is on Seaco Avenue in Deer Park, with machining, welding and engineering under one roof and field crews who go out to the plant when the equipment cannot come to us.
about.imageAlt: A large fabricated housing standing in the IMS shop

faqs.q: How quickly will someone get back to me?
faqs.a: Call or fill out the contact form and IMS staff will contact you within 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.q: Can I email instead of calling?
faqs.a: Yes. You can also reach us by email if you have a general inquiry.
When you call you will be connected directly to our expert service technicians.

faqs.q: Can I come by the shop?
faqs.a: Please reach out to us before visiting so we can schedule an appointment.
Extrusion equipment, gearboxes, turbines, pumps, blowers, induced and forced draft fans, rotary airlocks and valves.

faqs.q: Do you only work in the shop?
faqs.a: No. Shop repairs come to Deer Park, and our field service crews handle overhauls, installation, alignments, balancing and machining at your plant.
